_note: Ten: reframe something already established (a thread or one of the story's own fields). Never introduces a fresh fact: only threads, kept fields, and abstractions. Frames. Templates. {UPPERCASE} slots draw a fresh atom each time; {lowercase} slots are the story's own fields ({first}, {place}, {want}...). {the_thing}, {the_someone}, {the_message}, {the_disaster} reuse something an earlier beat introduced: favored when it exists, never used when it doesn't. Tagged entries are favored in those genres. {SLOT:feature} requires a feature (see frames.py); verbs bind to the subject and object around them; {was}/{is} agree with the noun before.
entries: Then {first} saw {the_thing} anew; it had never been about {want}.
